proof_basis: Complete written analytic derivations and independent internal AI review, not finite testing.

primary_exact_arithmetic.scope: Finite arithmetic supplements the written all-parameter proofs; no computational witness values or raw certificates are distributed.

second_kernel_algebra.scope: Exact kernel algebra and local-factor identities only; not an automated analytic verifier.

second_multiplicity_margins.scope: Rational constants only. Uniform analytic estimates are justified in the authored proofs.

edition_integrity.primary_audit: complete analytic proof/dependency text retained; one optional finite rational witness sentence omitted; review-boundary note appended
edition_integrity.complete_second_review_documents: complete analytic derivations retained; filename references adjusted; historical scope clarified by appendices

publication_boundary.content: Authored mathematical prose and public citations/verification metadata only

review_limitations: Unrefereed AI-assisted work; acceptance means independent internal AI review.
No external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification.
No novelty or coefficient-one resolution claim.
No certification of all broad-parameter statements or the full manuscript.
